about: The news from investor circles, angel to Series A, as a ledger and a graph. Public sources only, every item dated and linked, and no private person named.

item_fields.date: the date of the event, not of the fetch
item_fields.source_url: the public page the item is read from
item_fields.fetched: when the source was read, UTC
item_fields.sha256: hash of the frozen copy of the source
item_fields.edges: the graph edges this item adds

node_types.about: A startup that raised, or a company that bought one. Registered name and country.
A fund, an angel network or a corporate investor. Organisations only; private individuals are not named.
One raise: stage, amount if public, date, lead.
A contract term seen in public reporting, such as a preference, a pool size or a structure.
The public page an item came from, frozen and hashed.

edge_types.about: The investor took part without leading.
Derived: the two appear in the same round. Counted, never typed.
Public reporting says the round used this term.
